data.body: [P2] Do not block a live heartbeat follow-up on this status read. SDK retries or read timeouts can consume the heartbeat window before the queued follow-up is sent, causing the runner itself to time out an otherwise valid callback; a failed probe also aborts validation immediately even though it is only a dispatch guard. Keep this lookup off the deadline path—for example, dispatch the follow-up and reconcile an “execution already finished” rejection afterward, or use a strictly bounded probe with normal-polling fallback—and add delayed/failing status-probe tests.
